meta.name: Blood Legacy
meta.description: After years of estrangement, Khanyi Adesina returns home to fight for her family's business empire as it threatens to collapse under corruption.

videos.title: The Call
videos.overview: When her estranged father asks her to come home, journalist Khanyi learns he is planning to make her CEO of the family business.

videos.title: The Pruning
videos.overview: Khanyi weighs her father's offer after a confrontation with her brother Mandla, but a death in the family changes everything.

videos.title: The Wake
videos.overview: The Ndlovu siblings mourn their loss while trying to hide the details of what happened from family members, friends and the authorities.

videos.title: The Will
videos.overview: As the family gathers for the funeral, Khanyi learns who she's up against. Her mother Madlamini is left with a difficult choice.

videos.title: Descent
videos.overview: A violent attack on the company forces Khanyi to hold her own against a powerful gang. Gabisile grooms Siya to take over as CEO.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Thuli is on a mission to buy a house. Khanyi makes a bet with Mandla to resolve the drivers' strike and get sugarcane deliveries back on track.

videos.title: The Coronation
videos.overview: Khanyi's first day as CEO of Spear is immediately undermined by Mandla. At her boarding school, Amahle sees Nido's true colors.

videos.title: Filthy Rich
videos.overview: Feeling left behind, Akin considers an offer to dig into the Ndlovu family. Mandla hatches a plan to bring down Khanyi — and Spear along with her.

videos.title: The Anniversary
videos.overview: Following an act of sabotage, Khanyi reaches out to Zakhele for help with Spear's 25th anniversary celebrations. Siya is torn between love and duty.

videos.title: All that Glitters
videos.overview: Tensions rise at the anniversary party as the Ndlovu siblings continue to snipe at each other. Amahle catches Nido in a compromising position.

videos.title: The Lion's Den
videos.overview: Khanyi is swept up in the public backlash against Nido. Mandla attempts to strike a deal with the A6, but soon finds himself out of his depth.

videos.title: A Deal with the Devil
videos.overview: Tired of being sidelined, Lungelo breaks things off with Siya. Amahle publicly tells the truth of what she witnessed. Akin's editor pressures him.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: With Spear mired in scandal and debt, Khanyi organizes an asset sale that leaves Siya in a tough spot. Amahle's return to school is met with derision.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: As the sugarcane fields burn, Khanyi is left in the hot seat. Siya sends Nido abroad. The A6 ropes Mandla into a political assassination.

videos.title: Coup d'état
videos.overview: Thuli learns the truth of her mother's suicide. Akin confronts Khanyi about her suspected infidelity. Gabisile issues Siya an ultimatum.

videos.title: Revelations
videos.overview: With Dumi's help, Khanyi gets one step closer to finding her father's killer. Mandla is forced to take the blame for the assassination attempt.

videos.title: The Time for Truth
videos.overview: In the hope that Nido will come forward with the truth, Siya reveals his own. Zakhele scolds Mandla over his reckless behavior.

videos.title: Judas
videos.overview: Retracing her father's last steps, Khanyi finally discovers who was responsible for his death. Gabisile drives a wedge between Siya and Nido.

videos.title: House of Cards
videos.overview: With the police and the A6 closing in, Mandla tries to make amends. Khanyi leaks incriminating documents to the press, which has deadly consequences.

videos.title: The Harvest
videos.overview: With the future of Spear and the Ndlovu family hanging in the balance, Khanyi corners her father's killer — who has one card left to play.
